pathAssistantSteps.info: Pick the vehicle the customer is viewing and the viewing or test-drive date. Only available or reserved cars can be picked (US-01, US-07).
The price comes from the vehicle. Full payment: the sale price and a pickup date. Instalment: the Showroom Manager sets the duration (up to 12 months) and the down payment (at least 30%) (US-29).

Discounts: 5% or less is approved at once; more waits for Showroom Manager, Finance and Head Office, and the stage cannot move while one is pending (US-02, US-08). Fleet customers get their agreed rate (US-20). No discount on an individual's instalment sale (US-25). Instalment: Finance creates the plan and the Head of Finance signs it off once the deposit is in.
